name: TeamViewer
description: TeamViewer is a remote access and remote support platform that lets technicians connect to, control, and troubleshoot devices across Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android, and Chrome OS, free for personal, non-commercial use and paid for business use.
best_for: IT teams, MSPs, and support desks needing cross-platform remote access and remote support, plus individuals wanting free personal, non-commercial access to their own devices.
features: Remote access and remote support across Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android, and Chrome OS
Free for personal, non-commercial use by a single user; paid licensed plans for business and commercial use
TeamViewer AI credits for AI-assisted troubleshooting and automated session summaries
Remote printing, file transfer and queuing, session recording and playback, and "switch sides" role swapping
Optional add-ons: Endpoint Protection, Device Monitoring, Asset Management, and AR-powered remote assistance (TeamViewer Assist AR)
Phone support in 33 languages on paid plans
TeamViewer Tensor: a custom-quoted enterprise tier adding single sign-on, audit logging/API, and enhanced mass deployment
pros: Genuinely free for personal, non-commercial use, not just a time-limited trial
Available on essentially every major platform (Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android, Chrome OS, and Raspberry Pi, per TeamViewer's own download page)
Audited for SOC 2 and SOC 3 compliance and ISO/IEC 27001 certified, per TeamViewer's own trust center
cons: Business and commercial use requires a paid license -- the free tier is personal, non-commercial use only
Pricing is shown in the visitor's local currency and TeamViewer runs region-specific promotional coupon discounts, so list prices vary by region and by active promotion

tiers.name: Remote Access
tiers.notes: Figure shown on TeamViewer's Israel/MEA storefront -- teamviewer.com auto-detects visitor region and currency, so a US visitor may see a different, USD-denominated price on the same official pricing page. Access up to 3 unattended devices, 1 licensed user.

tiers.name: Business
tiers.notes: Regional (Israel/MEA) list price; TeamViewer showed a promotional price of ILS 119.20/month with coupon code CMP-BPC20-2026 at time of access -- promotional and time-limited. Access up to 200 unattended devices, 1 licensed user, 14-day free trial available.

tiers.name: Premium
tiers.notes: Regional (Israel/MEA) list price; TeamViewer showed a promotional price of ILS 264.72/month with coupon code CMP-BPC20-2026 at time of access -- promotional and time-limited. Access up to 300 unattended devices, 15 licensed users.

tiers.name: Tensor (Enterprise)
tiers.notes: Fully custom-quoted enterprise license. Adds single sign-on, audit log/API, enhanced mass deployment, and a larger AI credit allowance. Contact sales.

alternatives.name: NinjaOne
alternatives.description: NinjaOne is a unified IT operations platform combining RMM, patch management, backup, remote access, and service-desk ticketing for IT teams and MSPs.
alternatives.best_for: IT teams and MSPs wanting remote access bundled into a broader RMM, patching, and backup platform rather than a dedicated remote-support tool.
strengths: Remote access bundled with RMM and patching

alternatives.name: Atera
alternatives.description: Atera is an all-in-one RMM, ticketing, and patch management platform billed per technician with unlimited managed endpoints, plus a built-in remote-access add-on.
alternatives.best_for: IT teams and MSPs wanting remote access included as part of a broader per-technician RMM and ticketing platform.
strengths: Remote access bundled via the Work From Home add-on
Built-in AI Copilot and autonomous AI agent

faq.question: Is TeamViewer free?
faq.answer: Yes, for personal, non-commercial use by a single user. Business and commercial use requires a paid license; TeamViewer offers a 14-day free trial of its commercial plans.

faq.question: Why does TeamViewer's pricing look different depending on where I check it?
faq.answer: TeamViewer's pricing page auto-detects the visitor's region and shows localized currency, and at times region-specific promotional coupon discounts. Check the official pricing page from your own location for the exact current price in your currency.
